newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia tenders $56.9 million in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia tenders $56.9 million in T-bills.

text.p: The central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) on Thursday tendered for treasury bills valued at birr 390 milllion ($56.9 million).
The bills are for 28-day, 91-day and 182-day categories and will be issued on July 2, the bank said.
The amounts tendered were 200 million birr for 28-day bills maturing on 30 July, 140 million birr for 91-day bills maturing on 1 October and 50 million birr for 182-day bills maturing on December 31.
The bank said tenders should be deposited at the National Bank no later than June 30, while the auction result would be announced on July 2.
